description: This file defines a centralized state store for a gym management system using Zustand. It manages collections for classes, bookings, memberships, and selection details, providing fetch, create, update, delete, and selection actions. It references external APIs for data operations.

methods.name: fetchClasses
methods.description: Fetches a list of classes from the API and updates the store.

methods.name: createClass
methods.description: Creates a new class using the API and adds it to the store.

methods.name: updateClass
methods.description: Updates an existing class in the store with data from the API.

methods.name: deleteClass
methods.description: Removes a class from the store after deleting via API.

methods.name: createBooking
methods.description: Creates a booking and updates the store.

methods.name: updateBooking
methods.description: Updates a booking in the store with data from the API.

methods.name: deleteBooking
methods.description: Deletes a booking from the store.

methods.name: fetchMemberships
methods.description: Fetches memberships list from the API.

methods.name: selectEntity
methods.description: Selects an entity record by fetching detailed data.
